cohort: 21 patients with documented neonatal hypoglycemia-associated parieto-occipital brain injury who were followed at Kocaeli University Hospital Pediatric Neurology Department between 2007 and 2015
finding: Neonatal hypoglycemia was associated with a high incidence of neurodevelopmental impairments, including epilepsy (85.7%), cerebral palsy (33.3%), and abnormal visual evoked potentials (100%).
